exposure: risk factors for CE (parity >= 2, history of ectopic pregnancy, moderate-to-severe dysmenorrhea, hydrosalpinx, endometrial polyps, history of >= 2 uterine operations, recurrent implantation failure (RIF))
outcome: pregnancy outcome of frozen-thawed embryo transfer (FET)
cohort: The study included 1352 infertile patients who underwent hysteroscopy and diagnostic curettage, and a subset of whom underwent frozen-thawed embryo transfer (FET), at Nanjing Maternal and Child Health Hospital.
finding: Antibiotic treatment significantly improves reproductive outcomes, including lower miscarriage rates and higher singleton live birth rates, after frozen-thawed embryo transfer (FET) in patients with chronic endometritis (CE), especially in those with recurrent implantation failure (RIF).
